note: This table only narrows. It admits the local effects a Personal Manager workspace may perform after human approval, and blocks everything else. Assistant-originated proposals are additionally evaluated by the authoritative EDENA gateway policy, which remains authoritative wherever the two differ.

presentation.yellow: Yellow — needs your review before it happens

export_markdown.description: Write an accepted brief to a Markdown file in this workspace's exports folder.

blocked_effects.send_email: Drafting a message never sends it; sending is not available in the Personal Manager profile.
blocked_effects.post_message: Posting to Teams, Slack, or any channel is not available in the Personal Manager profile.
blocked_effects.publish: Publishing is not available in the Personal Manager profile.
blocked_effects.upload: Uploading to an external service is not available in the Personal Manager profile.
blocked_effects.delete_external: Deleting anything outside this workspace is not available.
